agent.evidence_ndvi: {{n}} NDVI composites are available; {{ok}} of {{checked}} checked periods agree with the expected crop calendar.
agent.evidence_smap: NASA SMAP surface soil moisture is available for {{n}} day(s) near this field; the comparison with the model is indicative.
agent.existing_position: Your existing rotation ranks {{rank}} of {{n}} candidate rotations on your priorities.
agent.missing_information: {{n}} information gap(s) affect this recommendation; they are listed with the result.
agent.ranking: Engine scores for the three strategies, out of 100, highest first: {{s1}}, {{s2}}, {{s3}}. The order follows the priorities you set.
agent.scores_relative: Scores are relative within the candidate pool, not absolute measures of performance.
agent.water_range: The simulation applies between {{min}} mm and {{max}} mm of irrigation across the three strategies; your existing rotation uses {{existing}} mm.
benefit.cover: The field has a crop on about {{pct}}% of days, which protects the soil from erosion and heat.
benefit.deep_roots: {{crop}} roots reach about {{cm}} cm, drawing on deeper water and nutrients.
benefit.diversity: Three different crop families across three seasons spread pest and nutrient pressure.
benefit.fodder: {{crop}} gives fodder value and ground cover; plan its termination before the next crop.
benefit.legume_n: {{crop}} is a legume and may add biologically fixed nitrogen (the amount depends on nodulation and management).
benefit.low_water: {{crop}} has a relatively low water demand.
conf.coarse_resolution: Climate data is coarse (about {{km}} km) compared with a single field.
conf.ec_estimated: Soil salinity is estimated, not measured.
conf.high_climate_variance: Performance varies across historical weather years (spread of {{spread}}, rank stability {{stability}}%).
conf.history_short: Fewer than three seasons of history.
conf.outside_delta: Location is outside the Nile Delta data area.
conf.soil_estimated: Organic matter or pH are estimates.
conf.soil_flags: Some crops in this rotation carry soil or water flags.
conf.synthetic_climate: Climate is a placeholder, not NASA data.
conf.texture_by_feel: Soil texture is a by-feel estimate.
conf.unreviewed_params: Crop parameters have not been reviewed by experts.
disclaimer.main: This tool supports, and does not replace, your own judgment and local agricultural expertise. Results are advisory estimates; confirm with a soil test and an agronomist before changing your rotation.
disclaimer.preview_data: Preview mode: climate values are synthetic until NASA data packs are loaded. Do not use these results for decisions.
disclaimer.support_not_replace: This advice supports your decisions and does not replace your experience or a local agronomist.
ev.climate_power: Daily climate from a NASA POWER data pack for this area.
ev.climate_synthetic: Daily climate from a synthetic Nile Delta placeholder; to be replaced with NASA data.
ev.guide_rule: Rotation rule "{{rule}}" from the field guide ({{ref}}).
ev.salt_tolerance: {{crop}} salinity threshold of {{thr}} dS/m (FAO salt-tolerance values, not yet reviewed).
ev.sim_irrigation: Simulation (FAO-56 ET0 x crop coefficients, layered water balance): about {{mm}} mm of applied water for {{et}} mm of crop and soil evaporation.
ev.soil_limits: Soil water limits for {{texture}} soil from the Saxton and Rawls pedotransfer functions.
ev.user_history: Your last {{n}} seasons of crop history.
flag.ec_estimated: Soil salinity (ECe) was not measured; it is estimated from irrigation-water salinity.
flag.history_short: Only {{n}} previous season(s) entered. Rotation checks are weaker with less history.
flag.no_feasible_rotation: No crop sequence passes all hard rules for this field. Review the constraints with a local expert.
flag.outside_delta: This location is outside the Nile Delta data area; regional values are less reliable.
flag.pest_unknown: A soil-borne problem is suspected but undiagnosed, so host crops cannot be ruled out reliably.
flag.ph_default: No pH entered; a typical value for irrigated Egyptian soils is assumed.
flag.pre_sowing_deficit: High initial soil moisture deficit ({{smd}} mm) detected from live Meteomatics observations. Consider pre-sowing irrigation to prevent seedling desiccation.
flag.texture_by_feel: Soil texture is a by-feel estimate. Confirm it with a lab texture test before commercial planting.
flag.unknown_crop: Crop "{{crop}}" is not in the knowledge base and was ignored.
gap.crop_params_unreviewed: Crop parameters are FAO defaults that agronomy experts have not reviewed yet.
gap.erosion_not_modelled: Erosion and compaction are not modelled.
gap.nasa_not_loaded: NASA data packs (POWER, GPM, SMAP, vegetation indices) are not loaded for this location.
gap.nitrogen_qualitative: Nitrogen effects of legumes and residues are qualitative; no fertilizer rates are given.
gap.no_prices: No farm-gate prices or yields were used; income is a qualitative class, not a profit forecast.
gap.pest_diagnosis: The nematode or soil-borne problem needs diagnosis; host status is species-specific.
gap.salinity_unmeasured: Soil salinity was not measured; the simulation relies on an estimate.
gap.smap_coarse: SMAP soil moisture is coarse (about 9 km) and shows regional conditions, not this field.
gap.soil_estimated: Texture, organic matter or pH are estimates; a lab test would raise confidence.
gap.synthetic_climate: Climate values are a synthetic placeholder, not NASA observations yet.
gap.variety: Variety, planting date and seed availability are not modelled.
nasa.ndvi_role: Vegetation greenness: bare-field periods and crop stress
nasa.power_role: Daily temperature, humidity, wind, radiation and rainfall for evapotranspiration
nasa.smap_role: Regional soil-moisture anomalies, to check simulated moisture
nasa.soilgrids_role: Modelled soil texture, carbon and pH where no soil test exists
ndvi.composite_smoothing: 16-day composites smooth the season and can hide short fallow gaps or quick crop changes.
ndvi.greenness_only: NDVI indicates vegetation greenness only; it is not a measure of soil health, crop identity or fertility.
ndvi.missing_pack: No NDVI composites are loaded for this location.
ndvi.pixel_mixing: A 500 m NDVI pixel covers many small fields, so it is an area average rather than this field.
ndvi.timeline_indicative: The bare-field versus crop check is an indicative interpretation, not a classification of your field.
rag.general_not_site: This is general agricultural knowledge, not evidence about a specific field.
rag.insufficient: The available agricultural sources do not cover this question, so no answer is given rather than an invented one.
rag.site_context_available: A farm profile was supplied: site-specific answers are available for questions about this field.
rag.sources_insufficient: No bundled source passed the relevance threshold for this question.
review.irrigation_schedule: Irrigation scheduling for your system and crop stage
review.pest_diagnosis: Diagnosis of nematodes or soil-borne disease
review.soil_test: Laboratory soil test (texture, pH, ECe, nutrients)
risk.fallow_season: No crop fits the {{season}} season for this pattern, so the field stays bare.
risk.heat_days: {{crop}} sees {{days}} days at or above 35 °C in the simulation.
risk.paddy_not_modeled: Flooded-paddy water management is not modelled; rice figures are indicative only.
risk.perennial: {{crop}} is a perennial and is not part of an annual rotation.
risk.pest_host: {{crop}} belongs to a family that may host the recorded soil-borne problem.
risk.rice_restricted: Rice is allowed only in locally approved areas; check the current regulations.
risk.salinity: At the estimated soil salinity, {{crop}} could reach only about {{yr}}% of its relative yield.
risk.salinity_loss: Salt build-up could cost {{crop}} about {{pct}}% of its relative yield (indicative).
risk.shallow_soil: Effective soil depth ({{depth}} cm) is shallow for {{crop}} roots.
risk.texture_poor: {{crop}} is a weaker match for {{texture}} soil and needs careful water and nutrient management.
risk.water_scarce: {{crop}} has a medium or high water demand, and water is limited for this field.
risk.water_stress: {{crop}} may face water stress on about {{pct}}% of its growing days in the simulation.
risk.waterlog: {{crop}} is sensitive to waterlogging and drainage here is poor.
rot.cereal_to_legume: {{crop}} (a legume) after the cereal {{prev}} changes crop family and nutrient demand; legumes may fix nitrogen where conditions allow.
rot.continuous_maize: Maize after maize is a continuous-cereal pattern; do not assume another grass crop breaks the disease cycle.
rot.family_repeat: The {{family}} family appears in most of the recent seasons.
rot.generic: A rotation rule flags this sequence for review.
rot.legume_to_cereal: {{crop}} after the legume {{prev}} can use part of the nitrogen the legume leaves behind; the amount is not fixed and depends on management.
rot.residue_diversify: {{crop}} diversifies residues and rooting depth compared with {{prev}}; manage high-carbon residues so they do not tie up nitrogen.
rot.rice_transition: Moving from rice to another crop depends on drainage, soil structure, salinity and planting time.
rot.same_family: {{crop}} follows a crop of the same family ({{family}}), which can carry over pests and diseases and repeat the same nutrient demand.
smap.area_average: Each SMAP value is a 9 km area average that mixes many fields, roads and channels.
smap.depth_mismatch: The model's top layer is about 20 cm deep while SMAP represents about 5 cm, so values are not expected to match exactly.
smap.missing_pack: No SMAP observations are loaded for this location, so no comparison is shown.
smap.not_ground_truth: The simulation is not ground truth and neither is the satellite: differences do not prove either one wrong.
smap.quality_filter: Only retrievals flagged as recommended quality on land are used; other observations are kept but excluded.
smap.surface_only: SMAP measures only the top few centimetres of soil; it does not observe root-zone moisture.
why.cover_vs_existing: Keeps a crop on the field for about {{days}} more days than your existing rotation.
why.existing_pattern: Repeats what you grew in each season last time, so you can compare it fairly against the alternatives.
why.family_break: {{crop}} is from a different crop family than {{prev}}, which helps break pest and disease cycles.
why.income_class: {{crop}} is in a higher market-return class (qualitative; no prices were used).
why.salt_ok: {{crop}} tolerates salinity up to about {{thr}} dS/m before yield loss begins, which fits this field's salt level.
why.water_vs_existing: Uses about {{pct}}% less irrigation water than your existing rotation (indicative simulation).
